tree.heading: Secretary of the Treasury
tree.text: The Secretary of the Treasury shall prescribe such regulations as may be necessary to carry out this title 1 and the amendments made by this title 1 (except as provided by subsection (b)).

tree.heading: Secretary of Labor
tree.text: The Secretary of Labor shall prescribe such regulations as may be necessary to carry out the labor value content determination under section 4532 of this title.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This title, referred to in subsec. (a), is title II of Pub. L. 116–113, Jan. 29, 2020, 134 Stat. 19, which enacted this subchapter and amended and enacted provisions set out as notes under several sections within this title. For complete classification of title II to the Code, see Tables.
